title: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDIN4NCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XII OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th April, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(12)/2002, dated
27‑4‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 32 of Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDIN4NCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XII OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th April, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(12)/2002, dated
27‑4‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 32 of
Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.‑‑‑In the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in
section 32, in the first proviso after the word "that", the word
"primary" shall be added and for the words "Taluka Municipal
Administration", the words "District Government" shall be
substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 103 of Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDIN4NCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XII OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th April, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(12)/2002, dated
27‑4‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
3. Amendment of section 103 of
Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.‑‑‑In the said
Ordinance, in section 103, in the proviso, for the full stop at the end a colon
shall be substituted and thereafter the following new proviso shall be added:‑
"Provided further that in
bringing parties to a dispute to an amicable settlement, Musalihat Anjuman
shall have regard to the provisions of section 345 of the Code of Criminal
Procedure (Act V of 1898), Hudood laws and all other laws for the time being in
force where under certain offences are not compoundable:
Provided also that every
settlement brought by Musalihat Anjuman as in a case pending before a Court
shall be subjected to the approval of such Court."

An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th April, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(12)/2002, dated
27‑4‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
4. Amendment of section 156 of
Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.‑‑‑In the said
Ordinance in section 156 after subsection (3) the following new subsection shall
be inserted:‑‑
"(3‑A) The period of
one year referred to in subsection (3) shall be computed from the date of
assumption of office of the Council:
Provided that in a year in which
general elections are to be held, the by election, may be held within eighteen
months".

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDIN4NCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XII OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th April, 2002]
No. S. Legis.I(12)/2002, dated
27‑4‑2002.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
5. Amendment of section 185 of
Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.‑‑‑In the said
Ordinance, in section 185, after subsection (2), the following new subsection
shall be added:‑‑
"(3) Notwithstanding
anything contained in sections 109 and 119, for the fiscal year 2001‑2002,
the Local Governments may not set apart fifty percent. of the development
budget for utilization specified therein:
Provided that the development
scheme proposed by the Citizen. Community Boards shall be given priority and
included in the budget presented to the Councils for approval."
